newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has downgraded its rating for Brazilian paper products maker Klabin to hold from buy and has cut its earnings estimates for the company.
-- "These reductions reflect mainly lower price assumptions," analyst Paulo Vasconcellos said in a report.
-- He said he has reduced his earnings forecast for Klabin to $28 million from $48 million, or $0.03 per share from $0.06, for 1997 and to $0.13 per share from $0.17.
-- "Although we estimate fiscal year 1997 earnings very similar to 1996, the first-quarter 1997 year-on-year comparison will look very ugly," he wrote.
-- He said he expects Klabin to report strong earnings growth in 1998 as a result of higher prices and volume growth but investors are likely to be disappointed until then.
-- Vasconcellos set a new year-end price target of $1.18 which he said represents an upside potential of 15 percent.
-- Klabin's common closed down 6.25 percent at 1.20 reais while its preferred plunged 9.09 percenmt to end at 1.00 reais Monday on the Sao Paulo exchange.
